capture_scope: Six complete CAN indices plus validated indexed prefix of seventh; original bags unchanged.

conventional_crc16_unknown_headers.method: All 32768 degree-16 polynomial hypotheses in both bit directions; XOR-differential samples remove init/xorout; every surviving hypothesis checked on all records. Four contiguous data-region hypotheses.

power_balance.hypothesis: Rear/front load raw counts=Nm; 0x2FA s16@64 /10 A; inverter voltage bytes16..17 = V. Unit hypotheses, not calibrated external torque/current measurements.

limits: Every ID has a numeric value dataset and a hypothesis; morphology-only is not a named physical meaning.
57 bodies lack excitation after protocol removal. Internet ID-only matches cannot uniquely identify constant signals.
Bit widths outside observed sign extension, sender identity, physical units and demand-versus-feedback roles can remain ambiguous.
Nominal-rate cyclic tests do not establish hardware CAN timing; no cyclic angle candidate survived the chosen model.
Current/power conversions are explicitly working hypotheses. A torque=1Nm/count and current=0.1A/count model failed drive-side power balance.
No vehicle/USB/CAN/UDS action, runtime pin/config/source changes, system installation, bag edits or external publication.
